string.text: Enables DLSS upscaling or native-resolution DLAA. For best image quality, disable other temporal anti-aliasing options.
Choose J, K, L or M. K is recommended. On some RTX cards L/M may reduce performance. Changing preset recreates NGX and resets temporal history.
J - Transformer, all RTX (K generally preferred)
Scales the Halton jitter passed to the engine and NGX together. 100 percent matches the previous validated setting. Smaller values can increase edge shimmer. Changing this resets temporal history.
Optional image sharpening after DLSS processing. 0 disables it; high values may restore aliasing. Start at 10-20 percent.
On: Sync Halton jitter to Screen Space Shaders. Off: Leave SSS jitter unchanged. Disable SSS TAA to avoid double temporal filtering.
DLAA improves anti-aliasing at native resolution. Quality, Balanced, Performance and Ultra Performance use DLSS upscaling. Selecting a new mode automatically applies the necessary renderer restart.
